relationships.subject: infraorbital nerve entrapment
relationships.evidence_quote: IoNE but not sham surgery induced significant mechanical allodynia in the ipsilateral vibrissal pad region

key_findings: After IoNE, NaV1.3, NaV1.7 and NaV1.8 mRNAs rise in the infraorbital nerve while most NaV mRNAs fall in the TG, with NaV1.8 protein increased in the nerve.
TTX-resistant A/C-fiber conduction becomes more sensitive to the NaV1.8 blocker after IoNE.
